W3forecast weekly 2x5k-uneven-soc30-sola: W3, uneven fleet after the weekly charge: an arbiter artifact, accepted by the user 2026-11-19. The arbiter keeps one fleet SOC (_split moves both batteries by the same points) and one fleet target per slot, so the battery with less room reaches max_soc early and the fleet halves its power: the block planned at 13:30 stores 5.06 kWh there, where the controller's per-battery split stores 5.23 of the plan's 5.24 (docs/plans/barrido/arranques/ctrlblock.py). Release passes; start cost 0 fails by more. Fix: per-battery SOC and targets in the arbiter's done layer.
W3: 100 % does not fit before the window ends (both arms miss it). The per-kWh shortfall penalty (D-8) buys all that fits; the sun after the window would have brought part of it for free.
W3forecast weekly 2x5k-uneven-soc70-sola: W3: the plan completes earlier than the previous allocator, buying part of the gap at a dearer hour to have the battery free for later (cheaper in its own model, which charges the fleet as a whole); the batteries' own tapers leave it a hair short of 100 % at the planned quarter and the overdue re-plan buys the rest.

W3: both arms complete at the same time with the same grid energy; they differ after it, when the new arm re-plans (D-9) with the ordinary optimizer, which charges late on a fleet whose batteries fill at different times and stores a little less for the evening. With the start cost the new arm marks more slots "to the end" here (one block): one falls short at half power once a battery is at its ceiling, and the arbiter does not carry the shortfall to the next slot (the controller does, _carry_over_slot_shortfall).
